caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet contains no linked_sequence_records rows; sequence identity cross-check used merged all_sequences.csv plus paper figures/supplement instead.
caution_findings.impact: Not blocking because linked assay and literature rows are source-verified, and modified analogue sequences preserve non-normalized X/bridge cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP analogue sequences 23300-23303 use X for modified Lys/Dap/vinyl-sulfide bridge positions; source figures/supplement support the modifications, but the final audit does not normalize them to canonical residues.
caution_findings.impact: Accepted with cautions; downstream sequence consumers must preserve modification labels.
